| Year | Epidemic |
|------|----------|
| 1348 | Black Death |
| 1575 | Large outbreak1 |
| 1629 | City‑wide epidemic2 |
| 1637 | Severe plague3 |

Thus, the city of Vivaldi’s birth, Venice, saw plague events **four times** in its major recorded history.
